hook.text: You watched 63 lives before breakfast. Allah gave you yours.

verses.text: “And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.”

end.text: You watched 63 lives before breakfast. Allah gave you yours.
end.gold: This morning: name 3 blessings before you open 1 app.

captions: 7:40 a.m. Tea going cold. Thumb still scrolling.
A beach in Bali. A new car. A wedding.
And a quiet voice inside: why not me?
Behind you, your mum puts warm bread on the table.
She's been up since six. You didn't even look up.
8:12 a.m. The train. Your phone stays in your pocket.
None of it was in a story. All of it was from Allah.

post.caption:
You watched 63 lives before breakfast. Allah gave you yours. 🤍

“And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.” (57:20)

This morning: name 3 blessings before you open a single app. Alhamdulillah for your own life.
